Who is Azzuri?

During the Earth's Second World War, Azzuri fought the that wanted to stay for the Vibranium. At the cost of five hundred Wakandans, Azzuri was able to defeat the that came. He ordered the s' bodies to burned, but also for their weapons to be studied. To keep Wakanda safe, Azzuri became a isolationist in order to protect his people from the and other enemies like Nazi Germany.
